description: This file contains functions to read and update boot configuration entries for Qualcomm boot partitions, including functions to swap active root filesystems and prepare for upgrades. It references external script sources such as functions.sh and bootconfig.sh, and defines internal functions like bootconfig_rw_index, tcl_swap_active_root, and tcl_upgrade_prepare.

methods.name: bootconfig_rw_index
methods.description: Reads or updates the index of a boot configuration entry in a specified partition, handling MTD device interactions.

methods.name: tcl_swap_active_root
methods.description: Switches the active root filesystem by modifying boot configuration entries.

methods.name: tcl_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the system for upgrade by setting boot delay and swapping active root if necessary.
